Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement preference: our default is PO (net-30) for anything over $10k ARR, but we can do card for a pilot if it helps speed things up. For enterprise procurement we’ll need an invoice + completed order form and a PO number.
2) Marketplace: we prefer transactable listings on AWS Marketplace where possible — it simplifies chargeback and approval. If you’re listed, include the marketplace option in the order form.
3) Security timeline: our security team plans to start the questionnaire next week; they usually take 7–10 business days for SOC/DPA + questionnaire combo. If you can provide initial answers/attachments up front that will help.

Outstanding question from security: do you provide an editable DPA (track-changes OK) and do you have a hosted SOC 2 report we can share with internal reviewers?

I’ll copy our procurement inbox on the next note (procurement@acmeanalytics.com).

Hi Jared / team —

Quick notes from the security/SE side to help the questionnaire:

- SOC 2 report: we can provide the full Type II report via secure transfer. The summary PDF Marissa attached includes control scope and third-party attestations.
- DPA: editable, track-changes allowed. Key items our legal team sees commonly: breach notification windows, subprocessor list, and data deletion timelines. We can mark standard redlines that are usually acceptable to enterprise buyers.
- Network / tenancy: Redwood offers both multitenant and dedicated (private) deployments. For Acme workloads with stricter tenancy requirements, we can outline the Dedicated option and what infra/hardening guarantees it includes.
- Security questionnaire: if you can forward the questionnaire (even an export), I’ll drop proposed answers into the template. Typical turnaround for the questionnaire is 3–5 business days for the first pass, longer if there are follow-ups.

If helpful, I can hop on a live call with your security reviewer to walk controls and provide demonstrable artifacts.
